text:
infra-bot: :warning: r3-21 observed rising p99 GPU tail latency across fractional tenants (p99=780ms over last 10m)

karen: noticed this on dashboard. pattern looks like repeated preemptions + small batch hogs on same NVLink domain

josh: can you paste the recent preempt logs? suspect noisy-job resubmits spiking GPU context switch

karen: snippet: `kubectl logs job/noisy-prep-112 -n tenant-a | tail -n 30` -> shows repeated SIGTERM then immediate restart

priya: also seeing egress queue backlog on top-of-rack switch for r3-21. maybe NIC queue saturation.
adrian: NIC counters?

priya: pulled counters: `ifstat r3-21` -> tx drops rising from 0 to 120/min when p99 spikes

josh: if it's both preempt churn + NIC drops, multi-factor noisy neighbor. options: 1) throttle offending pod's burstcap, 2) soft-isolate tenants to a fractional dedicated slice, 3) shift latency-sensitive tenants off rack

karen: prefer soft-isolate first. cheaper than cross-AZ shifts. we can create a transient dedicated slice for that NVLink domain (slice tag: r3-21-noisy-mit)

adrian: cost/impact: transient slice for 1 NVLink domain across 3 hosts reduces available shared capacity ~6% region-wide, but buys p99 improvement. need approval from cost team if >12h

josh: quick mitigation: apply per-tenant egress policer and lower pod restart backoff to avoid tight respawn loops. also set `preempt_protect:true` on latency-sensitive pods to avoid collateral

priya: config I propose:
```
policies:
  tenant_a:
    egress_policer: 50mbps
    restart_backoff: 45s
  soft_isolate:
    tags: [r3-21-noisy-mit]
    duration: 2h
```

adrian: ack. who will execute? need to coordinate with release window (no large deploys for 30m)

karen: I can roll the policer now. josh, can you create the soft slice and add tenant-a,b to it?

josh: creating slice: `slicectl create --hosts r3-21[1-3] --tag r3-21-noisy-mit --ephemeral 2h` -> started. adding tenants a,b now.

infra-bot: Change detected: slice r3-21-noisy-mit created by josh at 2026-03-05T19:12:00Z

priya: monitoring p99 and if drops below 400ms in 15m we keep for 2h then reassess. if fragmentation metric free_slots_pct drops >8% we revert

adrian: also add fallback routing: if slice saturates, route latency-sensitive calls to quantized-2 model in same AZ with hedging enabled

karen: noted. josh, push routing rule?

josh: pushed. command: `routectl apply --rule "prefer:slice(tag=r3-21-noisy-mit) -> fallback:quantized-2@az=r3"`

priya: early signs: p99 went to ~380ms after 6m. KV missrate down 28%
adrian: good. cost estimate: ~+3% reserved for ephemeral 2h, +5% if extended >24h. I'll file a quick ticket for finance if we keep beyond 24h

karen: ok folks, leave this thread here. we'll keep monitoring for 2h. tagging oncall @adrian for next 30m. :thumbsup:
